title: A Valorant player says they got banned after accidentally buying a cheater’s used CPU.
summary: Buying used PC parts to dodge price hikes could come with a catch, like the hardware ban a Reddit user claims they got stuck with after trying to run Valorant with a pre-owned Ryzen 7 5800X3D.
